body:
Canonical execution plan: docs/engine/exterior-readiness-plan.md.

Outcome
Make Oblivion Tamriel, FO3 Megaton/Capital Wasteland, FNV WastelandNV, Skyrim Tamriel, and FO4 Commonwealth dependable exterior runtime profiles: deterministic world selection, safe entry, bounded streaming, clean ownership, visual continuity, and persistent world simulation.

Definition of done
- Requested worldspace/CELL selection is deterministic and diagnosable.
- Character entry has verified ground or a safe explicit fallback.
- A deterministic path crosses 2+ boundaries without hitches, holes, leaks, or temporal/environment discontinuity.
- Stream-out reclaims every ECS/physics/GPU/audio/script owner modulo bounded caches.
- Near terrain, 4/8/16/32 LOD, objects, ground cover, water, sky, and fog join without overlap or gaps.
- Door transitions and save/load preserve worldspace/grid/player/weather/change forms.
- REGN/NAVM/audio/AI and load-order overrides behave as streamed world systems.

Dependency order
1. #2368 — EX-01/05 smoke matrix + image/non-finite gates.
2. #2375 — EX-02/04 foreground readiness + safe ground.
3. #2376 — EX-06/07 boundary benchmark + measured deadlines.
4. #2374 — EX-08 cancellation/resource ownership soak.
5. #2370 — EX-09/17 transitions, persistence, load-order conformance.
6. #2371 — EX-10/11 near terrain + complete distant LOD.
7. #2373 — EX-12/13 environment + water continuity.
8. #2369 — EX-14/15 ground cover, persistent refs, parent worlds, FO4 spatial data.
9. #2372 — EX-16 REGN/NAVM/audio/AI integration.

Already closed/related
- EX-03 deterministic worldspace selection: #2340.
- Stale Oblivion exterior documentation: #2348.

Execution rule
Each slice lands a pure/unit guard where possible and a real-data artifact-producing smoke profile where format/runtime behavior is the actual contract. Performance reports distributions and worst atomic work, not average FPS alone.

comments.body: Tranche A progress (2026-08-04): the five-game smoke/artifact matrix is green, foreground authored-content readiness and safe FlyCam fallback are implemented, focused tests pass, and stale Oblivion/FO3 readiness prose has been corrected. Open work within the tranche is the renderer-side pre-tonemap non-finite counter (#2368); the safe-ground collision half remains in #2375. The next dependency is the two-boundary timing harness in #2376.

Execution checkpoint, 2026-08-04:

- EX-01 static five-game matrix: green.
- EX-02 diagnostic/safe-FlyCam half: implemented.
- EX-06 deterministic three-boundary path and bounded telemetry: implemented.
- EX-07: global geometry device-loss fix plus per-hash precombine yielding implemented; FO4 worst apply slice improved 2.55 s -> 293 ms.
- Current measured blockers: FO4 7.25 s handoff, 745 ms unload, 816 ms worst frame with superseded/unsettled crossings; Skyrim 8.14 s LOD handoff.

The comprehensive plan and live baselines are updated in docs/engine/exterior-readiness-plan.md. Work continues with sub-hash decode/upload/BLAS and resumable teardown before the EX-08 ownership soak.

Checkpoint correction: the earlier FO4 supersession was partly benchmark-induced because frame-indexed motion gave a faster renderer less wall time between crossings. grid-cross now pauses during active handoffs and FO4 passes all three independent settlements with no Vulkan failure or supersession.\n\nThe remaining P0 is performance, not correctness masking: FO4 full/LOD max 18.71/18.73 s, unload 848 ms, apply 315 ms, frame max 860 ms. A sub-hash BLAS fragmentation attempt was measured and removed after regressing first settlement to 32.73 s.

Execution update: exterior teardown is no longer the dominant FO4 boundary hitch. Commits 3205506d and ede92928 add batched global finalization, phase telemetry, and ECS batch despawn. Live FO4 unload improved 836.69 -> 100.96 ms and entity despawn 757.79 -> 13.13 ms while preserving population, draws, 3/3 settlement, and device stability. Remaining P0 measurements are GPU release 83.20 ms, single-hash apply 316.40 ms, frame max 547.95 ms, and full/LOD handoff 19.06/19.08 s. Next work stays in EX-07 and must preserve BLAS batch throughput; the previously rejected tiny-submission split remains rejected.

Plan correction for EX-07: BLAS was not the main single-hash tail. Live timing shows 20-24 ms BLAS and <=21 ms prepare versus 273-385 ms CPU spawn/texture/mesh upload. Even with one preserved BLAS batch per hash, per-mesh CPU yielding regressed settlement to 50.27 s / 105.66 s and timed out at 300 s on crossing 3, so that cursor was removed. The action plan now explicitly requires preserving CPU wall throughput as well as GPU submission throughput.

Execution update: batched mesh/texture cache purges reduce FO4 unload GPU time from 81.20 to 23.16 ms and total unload from 98.88 to 40.18 ms without changing population, draws, settlement, or device stability. The remaining 551 ms frame tail correlates with a coherent 800-900 MiB global geometry SSBO rebuild under the device-idle safety path. Plan step EX-07 remains active on capacity-managed global geometry and throughput-preserving single-hash CPU upload.
